# DefaultPalette

**Tags:** `palette`

The single shared 256-entry palette for the character system. Characters store color indices; the shader samples this palette texture. One byte per index keeps network and persistence cost flat (§19).

> **Goal:** Define the controlled color space that preserves the pixel-art art direction

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `entries` | json | yes | 256 hex color strings, region-grouped (§19) |
| `regions` | json | yes | Named 32-entry region bounds for the 256-entry palette (§19) |
